whyChooseUs.heading: Why Families Choose Book My Pooja for Iyer Booking

items.title: Verified Iyers, Not Random Contacts
items.description: Finding the right Iyer through unknown contacts can be stressful, especially for important family rituals. Book My Pooja helps you connect with verified and experienced Iyers based on your pooja requirement, location, date, and availability.

items.title: Right Iyer for the Right Ritual
items.description: Every ceremony has a different traditional process. Whether it is Griha Pravesh, Ganapathi Homam, Ayush Homam, Satyanarayana Pooja, Upanayanam, Seemantham, Naming Ceremony, or marriage rituals, our team helps you find a suitable Iyer for that specific requirement.

items.title: Tamil Tradition & Language Comfort
items.description: For many families, pooja feels more meaningful when the rituals are performed in the language and tradition they follow. We help arrange Iyers who can guide your family clearly and perform the ceremony with proper traditional understanding.

items.title: Complete Coordination Before the Pooja
items.description: Our coordinator helps you plan all important details before confirmation, including pooja type, date, time, location, samagri requirement, package discussion, and Iyer availability.

items.title: Samagri Guidance or Arrangement Support
items.description: You do not have to worry about missing important pooja items. We can share the required samagri list in advance or help with complete samagri arrangement based on your requirement.

items.title: Package Clarity Before Confirmation
items.description: Before booking, you get clarity on Iyer availability, ritual requirements, package details, samagri support, and coordination process, so there is no confusion later.
